meta.name: Pluto TV Cult Films
meta.description:
From the “so bad it’s good to the “so weird it’s great, Pluto TV Cult Films is like having your own personal drive-in movie theater playing the wildest, funniest, and most-beloved cult classics ever made.

Shows: From Dusk Till Dawn, Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin, Vampire in Brooklyn, Friday the 13th - Part III, April Fool's Day
Available on: Pluto TV
